test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.**

You must seize the opportunity __to make amends__ for your earlier curtness.
solution: The correct answer is **'to correct a mistake'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom 'To make amends' is 'to correct a mistake'. • **To make amends:** to do something to correct a mistake that one has made or a bad situation that one has caused. (किसी गलती को सुधारने के लिए कुछ करने के लिए जो किसी ने की है या एक बुरी स्थिति जो किसी के कारण हुई है) • *Example: She tried **to make amends** by apologizing to him.* • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is** Option 1.** ​ **Correct Answer:__** *To correct a mistake.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at some idioms the word 'Get' are: **Idiom** **Meaning** **Example** Get socked with something to suddenly receive something that causes you problems. (अचानक कुछ ऐसा प्राप्त करना जिससे आपको परेशानी हो) *If you don't pay your credit card bill on time, you'll get socked with a huge late fee.* Get someone's wires crossed to have a different understanding of the same situation. (एक ही स्थिति की एक अलग समझ रखने के लिए) *We must have got our wires crossed – I thought she was arriving tomorrow, not today.* Get something out of your system to do something enough so that you do not want to do it any longer. (इतना कुछ करने के लिए कि आप इसे अब और नहीं करना चाहते हैं) *Let the kids run around a little longer, maybe they’ll get it out of their system.* c3:T2428, The correct answer is** She said to me, “How tall you have grown!”**
